toolArguments.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent pixel-art combat sprite atlas for an independent crossover game, freshly drawn original game-asset adaptation (not official frames). ONE adult male: Corporal Dwayne Hicks from Aliens (1986). Recognizable short brown hair, green-brown Colonial Marine field armour, camouflage trousers, combat boots, physical M41A pulse rifle, no helmet for consistent visible adult face. Exactly 16 genuinely different full-body poses, strict 4 columns by 4 rows, uniformly spaced rectangular cells, no labels or grid lines. Every pose faces RIGHT in a three-quarter side battle view. Transparent background, alpha gaps around every body and weapon, all rifle barrels and boots completely inside each cell with generous gutters. Same character, weapon, costume, anatomy and physical scale in all cells. Row 1 ARRIVAL: four different walking-to-bracing steps, muzzle lowered safely; row 2 PREPARATION: four progressive aiming poses bringing rifle from lowered to horizontal shoulder aim; row 3 ATTACK: four different braced rifle firing/recoil poses, rifle shouldered and barrel facing right, very small physical muzzle flash on only third pose, hands remain attached to rifle; row 4 RECOVERY: four different lowering-and-withdrawing poses, no more gunfire. Ordinary aimed fire only; no laser, aura, summoned creature, magic, gore, victim or other character. Clean crisp pixel clusters and readable adult silhouette. Native atlas canvas 1024 by1536, full transparency.

Create a transparent pixel-art 16-pose RPG reinforcement sprite sheet for an independent crossover game. Freshly drawn original game asset adaptation, not official frames. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of full-body poses, no labels, no grid lines, clean empty alpha gutters, consistent costume/anatomy/scale in every cell, readable crisp pixel clusters. Every pose faces RIGHT in side/three-quarter battle view. Four genuinely distinct successive poses per row: ARRIVAL, PREPARATION, ACTION, RECOVERY. Whole subject and equipment always remain fully contained with generous padding. Image1024x1536 with real transparent alpha. No background, no ground, no other character, no injuries or gore. ONE ATLAS robot from Portal2 (2011): short spherical white-and-grey body, one circular BLUE central optic, two thin mechanical arms and two thin legs, right hand holding the normal Aperture portal device. ATLAS is NOT the tall narrow orange-eyed P-Body. Row1 four different approach steps. Row2 four different cooperative testing gestures with the device safely lowered. Row3 four different clear arm/optic signals giving a teammate route guidance; ZERO attack, no muzzle, no energy shot, no portal laser, no glowing aura, no shield. Row4 four different lowering-and-withdrawing steps. Clean small native robot body with visible thin hands and feet. Keep the portal device nonoffensive and the single blue optic consistent.
